purpose: Turn the existing Workstream-11 motion/material recipes into deterministic normal-motion keyframe and trace windows for later Workstream-15-coordinated implementation and Workstream-14 rendered QA. This file creates no gameplay state and does not claim that any motion currently renders on branch.

auraFreeze.rule: No Aura regeneration, alteration, remap or re-review unless a later exact-hash defect is recorded.

upstreamVisualContracts.rule: This contract narrows capture timing only. If it conflicts with semantic, accessibility, protected-zone or cleanup rules in upstream contracts, the stricter upstream rule wins.

captureClock.t0: The first animation-frame opportunity after the existing semantic state is already true and the destination remains interactive.
captureClock.preEvent: Capture immediately before the semantic state change where the fixture supports it.
captureClock.settled: Transient movement has ended; persistent truthful state material remains.
captureClock.cleanup: Transient overlays are absent after superseding state, navigation, reduced-motion preference change or the bounded cleanup deadline.
captureClock.interactionRule: No visual effect may delay mount, focus, pointer input, scrolling, answer availability, equip availability, navigation or screen-reader exposure.
captureClock.qaDeterminism: QA fixtures may use a fixed visual-only seed so particle positions are reproducible. The QA seed must not alter gameplay, rewards, learning, ownership, saves or persistence.

visualStoryboard.0: Destination content is mounted, readable and interactive in its truthful state; optional entry wrapper may begin slightly translucent and 2-6 px from final position.
visualStoryboard.90: Chrome/scene is visibly settling; no content is withheld and no focus/pointer layer is blocked.
visualStoryboard.220: Most opacity/translate delta is resolved; geometry remains unchanged.
visualStoryboard.360: Final static composition exactly matches the persistent visual state; entry wrapper has no residual transform.

screenEntry.reducedMotion: Capture final truthful state at t0; no entrance opacity/translate sequence.

storeSelection.semanticPrerequisite: Existing selected-item state is true before t0.

visualStoryboard.0: Selected card receives its persistent stronger cyan/ice rim immediately; detail/try-on content is already available.
visualStoryboard.120: Local spark path has begun outside name/price bands; no card resize or grid reflow.
visualStoryboard.320: Mid-travel frame shows near/mid/far scale hierarchy without obscuring item art or avatar face.
visualStoryboard.480: Destination emphasis is at or near peak while selected semantics remain readable without motion.
visualStoryboard.640: Travel has ended; persistent selected rim and restrained destination halo remain.
visualStoryboard.820: All transient particles are gone. Persistent selected material remains until real state changes.

storeSelection.reducedMotion: At t0 show persistent selected rim plus fixed destination halo only; no travel, pulse, bounce or scale animation.

storeEquip.semanticPrerequisite: Existing equipped state is true before t0; never infer success from click intent alone.

visualStoryboard.0: Persistent equipped cue is already visible on the truthful equipped destination.
visualStoryboard.140: Local destination burst begins around, not over, the equipped art/face.
visualStoryboard.360: Depth-staggered star/mote field expands locally; no full-grid animation or purchase-state implication.
visualStoryboard.520: Peak emissive/glint moment remains bounded to the destination surface.
visualStoryboard.720: Burst has settled; equipped semantic cue remains independently legible.
visualStoryboard.920: Transient burst is fully removed; no detached overlay survives scrolling or navigation.

storeEquip.reducedMotion: At t0 use persistent equipped cue plus fixed three-to-five-star cluster outside critical detail; no traveling particles.

questCorrect.semanticPrerequisite: Reliable existing semantic correct state is true before t0; Workstream 12 semantics remain authoritative.

visualStoryboard.0: Green success keyline appears immediately without moving answer geometry; next available action is not delayed.
visualStoryboard.140: Gold/ice spark burst starts outside answer copy.
visualStoryboard.420: Peak celebration is local, legible and clearly post-correctness; no answer text is covered.
visualStoryboard.680: Particle density is decaying while static green success remains.
visualStoryboard.860: Transient particles are gone or visually negligible; persistent truthful success styling may remain only while the correct state remains active.

questCorrect.reducedMotion: At t0 show instant static green success keyline plus a small fixed gold/ice star cluster outside answer copy.

questWrongClueRetry.visualStoryboard: All sampled frames contain instructional feedback only: zero Star Sparks, gold reward flare, success bloom, celebratory bounce or answer-hinting emphasis.
questWrongClueRetry.cleanupRequirement: Any prior correct-state decoration must be absent by the first frame judged as wrong, clue, retry or next unanswered.

homeRoomReveal.semanticPrerequisite: Real room progression is already loaded before t0.

visualStoryboard.0: All five truthful room-tier previews are already present, readable and interactive; optional visual settle starts from a shallow opacity/translate delta only.
visualStoryboard.180: Tiles may differ slightly in settle phase, but none may be hidden or semantically withheld.
visualStoryboard.420: Current true tier carries warm-gold emphasis; locked tiers remain truthfully locked.
visualStoryboard.760: All five previews are fully settled in final geometry with zero reveal dependency left.

homeRoomReveal.reducedMotion: All five truthful tiles render immediately in final positions at t0 with the same current/locked materials.

avatarBuddyVisualLife.scope: Optional wrapper-only ambient life after layout is stable; never required for state comprehension.
avatarBuddyVisualLife.visualStoryboard: One subtle drift/sway cycle returns exactly to rest, then holds static before another optional cycle. Avatar and Buddy should not share identical phase. No face occlusion or layout movement.
avatarBuddyVisualLife.phoneRule: At 390x844 and 320x568, omit the ambient cycle whenever it competes with reading or critical controls.
avatarBuddyVisualLife.reducedMotion: No transform loop; preserve fixed rim light, contact shadow and static Buddy highlight.

viewportRestraint.1408x1056: Use authoritative desktop composition/material hierarchy. Keep event accents local to the reference-defined effect zones.
viewportRestraint.1024x768: Keep the same timing but reduce halo spread and protect dense labels; do not enlarge effects to compensate for tighter space.
viewportRestraint.390x844: Keep timing bounded; reduce decorative spread/scale before reducing semantic clarity. Optional ambient avatar/Buddy cycle may be omitted.
viewportRestraint.320x568: Use minimum spectacle compatible with the normal-motion recipe. State clarity, answer copy, labels, prices and focus cues outrank decorative effects.

protectedVisualRegions: Store item name and price bands
cleanupTriggers: new same-surface event supersedes the old one

normalMotionEvidence: Capture the listed exact keyframes for Store selection and equip, Quest correct, Home room reveal and screen entry.
Capture Quest wrong/clue/retry at all listed samples and verify zero celebration material.
Capture one optional avatar/Buddy micro-cycle only where present; verify exact return to rest and the required static dwell.
After Store selection/equip, perform a meaningful grid scroll only after transient particles are cleaned; verify persistent selected/equipped cues remain attached to the correct surface.

traceWindows.event: Record browser paint/composite behavior from one frame before t0 through at least 300 ms after the settled frame.
traceWindows.scroll: Record one Store scroll with persistent selected/equipped state visible and with no transient particle layer alive.
traceWindows.preferenceTransition: Toggle to reduced motion while a fixture event is active and verify transient motion layers are synchronously removed without changing semantic state.

measureAndReport: main-thread long tasks observed during the bounded event
whether reduced-motion final state preserves equal semantic readability
renderQaPacket.automaticVisualMetricPolicy: pHash, dHash, color-hash and SSIM may be reported for inspection prioritization only and may not approve or reject motion/effect quality automatically.

failConditions: Any effect delays learning, navigation, selection, equip, focus, pointer input or scrolling.
Any success effect appears on Quest wrong/clue/retry/unanswered.
Any effect visually hints the correct answer before correctness is established.
Any room tile is hidden or made non-interactive until its reveal completes.
Any particle/halo obscures protected text, avatar face or equipped-item detail.
Any transient layer survives its cleanup trigger or becomes detached during scrolling.
Reduced motion removes the only visible selected/equipped/correct/current-tier cue.
A responsive capture is represented as pixel parity without an authoritative mobile reference.
